blocks.text: Match preview: Western Australia face Tasmania in 3rd Match (ODI) on Sun, 20 Sept, 2026, 11:30 am at W.A.C.A. Ground Perth. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Pace and bounce typical of Australian wickets; good carry for fast bowlers.
Light drizzle · High 20°C / Low 13°C · Rain: 1.4 mm · Wind: up to 7 km/h. Light rain possible — overcast conditions could assist swing bowling early.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
